entries.name: FamilyCircle
entries.note: Family account membership is served by the vendor's family cloud; BifrOSt has no family account service, so there is no membership to manage.

entries.name: FamilyCircleUI
entries.note: Interface for the vendor's family account membership, which needs that vendor's family cloud and has no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: FamilyControls
entries.note: Child restrictions (downtime, time limits and URL filter rules) are covered by the SDK screen time module and the core content filter; family account sync and per-child reporting to a vendor cloud are not built.

entries.name: FamilyControlsObjC
entries.note: Objective-C bindings are not needed on BifrOSt; the Rust SDK screen time module and the core content filter provide the same restriction logic.

entries.name: FamilyControlsSlotSupport
entries.note: Tried: the reference extract holds only the Info.plist; the name suggests the settings slot for child restrictions, which the shell's settings intents may route, but this is not verified.

entries.name: FamilyNotification
entries.note: The notification relay for family accounts depends on the vendor's account service, and BifrOSt has no family account to notify.

entries.name: FeatureFlags
entries.note: Server-driven feature flags for the vendor's own apps and profiles are delivered from that vendor's servers; BifrOSt takes no flags from a vendor server.

entries.name: FeatureFlagsSupport
entries.note: Support code for the vendor's server-driven feature flags, which BifrOSt does not receive from any vendor server.

entries.name: FeatureStore
entries.note: Tried: the reference extract holds only the Info.plist and version plist; the name suggests a machine learning feature store for the vendor's assistant, which is not verified.

entries.name: FedStats
entries.note: Federated statistics for the vendor's telemetry are gated by a consent configuration and telemetry allow lists, and they upload to the vendor; BifrOSt sends no vendor telemetry.

entries.name: FedStatsEncoder
entries.note: Encoder for the vendor's federated telemetry streams, which the reference telemetry allow list names; BifrOSt sends no such telemetry.

entries.name: FedStatsPlugin
entries.note: Plug-in for the vendor's federated telemetry; its consent configuration and telemetry allow list name vendor services, and BifrOSt sends no telemetry.

entries.name: FedStatsPluginCore
entries.note: Core of the vendor's federated telemetry plug-in, which depends on the vendor's consent service; BifrOSt sends no telemetry.

entries.name: Feedback
entries.note: The bug report model, server limits, diagnostics and redaction are in the SDK, and the client posts to the BifrOSt Cloud bug API; the reference feedback assistant interface and its vendor destinations are not built.

entries.name: FeedbackCore
entries.note: The report model that feedback submissions use is covered by the SDK bug report module; the reference storage model and its vendor-side records are not reproduced.

entries.name: FeedbackLogger
entries.note: The crash and stall records a feedback logger collects are covered by the SDK diagnostic report module; the logging subsystem itself is not built.

entries.name: FeedbackService
entries.note: Collecting and posting a report is covered by the SDK bug report client; there is no system feedback daemon and no vendor feedback remote view.

entries.name: FileBrowsingServices
entries.note: Tried: the reference extract holds the path resolver XPC binary and Info.plist, but its request contract was not read, so the owner of file path resolution is not confirmed.

entries.name: FileDerivativeDaemon
entries.note: The thumbnails service draws and caches pictures of files for every app, with a request plan and a generation state machine in the SDK (thumbnails.rs). Gap: the shared preview generator does not yet cover documents or media beyond the providers in springboard/src/thumbs, and no derivative cache is shared with the file browser's previews.

entries.name: FileDerivatives
entries.note: Build shared thumbnail and preview generation with a cache for files shown in the file browser and quick-look views; no such generator exists in springboard.

entries.name: FileProviderDaemon
entries.note: private framework, owner FileProvider; from SDK matrix file-provider.json

entries.name: FileProviderTelemetry
entries.note: private framework, owner FileProvider; from SDK matrix file-provider.json

entries.name: FileVault
entries.note: Full disk encryption is LUKS2, unlocked at boot by the loader and the initcpio hook; the reference recovery key and account escrow are not built.

entries.name: FilesActionsUI
entries.note: Tried: the reference extract holds only the Info.plist; the name suggests file action menus, but the interface contract is not verified.

entries.name: FinHealthCore
entries.note: private framework, owner n/a: HealthKit data is not mirrored

entries.name: FinHealthInsights
entries.note: private framework, owner n/a: HealthKit data is not mirrored

entries.name: FinanceDaemon
entries.note: Bank connections and transaction matching for the vendor's wallet service run on that vendor's finance cloud; BifrOSt has no bank account source to match against.

entries.name: FindMyBase
entries.note: Shared base for the vendor's device location service, whose records and accounts sit in that vendor's cloud; BifrOSt has no such service.

entries.name: FindMyBluetooth
entries.note: Offline location beacons for the vendor's accessory network need the vendor's accessory hardware and location network, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: FindMyCloudKit
entries.note: Cloud record sync for the vendor's device location service is served from that vendor's cloud; BifrOSt runs no such service.

entries.name: FindMyCommon
entries.note: Tried: the reference extract holds no binary or resource for this framework; the name shows shared device location code, but its exact purpose is not confirmed.

entries.name: FindMyCore
entries.note: Shared model layer of the vendor's device-location service (its Models and Intelligence string tables); the service runs on the vendor's cloud location network, which BifrOSt does not operate.

entries.name: FindMyCrypto
entries.note: Key handling for the vendor's encrypted location reports, which are relayed through the vendor's cloud network; BifrOSt has no location network to encrypt for.

entries.name: FindMyDaemonSupport
entries.note: Helper code for the vendor's device-location daemons; it only serves that location service.

entries.name: FindMyDevice
entries.note: Erase, sound, identity and shared-configuration XPC services for devices signed in to the vendor's cloud account; they act on that account service, which BifrOSt does not have.

entries.name: FindMyDeviceAccessories
entries.note: Pairing and status of the vendor's own tracking accessories; these are vendor hardware that BifrOSt does not support.

entries.name: FindMyDeviceUI
entries.note: User interface of the vendor's device-location service (its own icon and string table); it has no meaning without that service.

entries.name: FindMyFeatureFlags
entries.note: Feature-flag switches that gate the vendor's device-location server features only.

entries.name: FindMyLocate
entries.note: Location lookup for the vendor's device-location service over the vendor's cloud network.

entries.name: FindMyLocateObjCWrapper
entries.note: Objective-C wrapper over the vendor's location lookup library; it serves that service only.

entries.name: FindMyMac
entries.note: Background daemon and trust XPC service that tie a computer to the vendor's device-location and activation-lock cloud account; that account link has no BifrOSt meaning.

entries.name: FindMyMessaging
entries.note: Location-sharing messages that the vendor's device-location service sends to contacts through the vendor's messaging service.

entries.name: FindMyPairing
entries.note: Pairs the vendor's tracking accessories with the vendor's cloud account; there is no BifrOSt counterpart.

entries.name: FindMySecureEnvironment
entries.note: XPC service that keeps device-location keys in the vendor's secure element; BifrOSt has no hardware path for that service.

entries.name: FindMyServerInteraction
entries.note: Client for the vendor's device-location servers; BifrOSt runs no such server.

entries.name: FindMyStorage
entries.note: Storage of the vendor's device-location records and their cloud sync.

entries.name: FindMyUnsafeAsyncBridging
entries.note: Bridges asynchronous calls for the vendor's device-location service; it serves that service only.

entries.name: FinderKit
entries.note: The Files app builds the sidebar (Favorites, Locations, Tags), icon, list and column views, the path bar, Trash and tag dots. Gap: the vendor's proximity-sharing view is not built, and the Files app is not compared with this framework one view at a time.

entries.name: FinderSyncPriv
entries.note: private framework, owner FinderSync; from SDK matrix finder-sync.json

entries.name: FlexMusicKit
entries.note: Only the Info.plist and a resource-rules file are in the reference extract, so the purpose is not known; the identifier and bundle contents do not explain it.

entries.name: FlightUtilities
entries.note: Flight information views (their nib files) that show the vendor's travel status cards; the status data comes from the vendor's cloud, and BifrOSt has no flight data source.

entries.name: FlightUtilitiesCore
entries.note: No resources in the reference extract beyond the Info.plist; its sibling flight-information framework shows flight views, but this core layer's role is not confirmed.

entries.name: FlowFrameKit
entries.note: Only the Info.plist is in the reference extract; the vendor identifier suggests assistant flow frames, but no code or resource confirms its role.

entries.name: FlowToolTypes
entries.note: Type definitions for the vendor's voice-assistant tool calls; the types only describe that assistant's tool bundles.

entries.name: FlowTools
entries.note: Tool layer of the vendor's voice assistant; its intent metadata describes that assistant's own tool actions.

entries.name: FlowToolsRegistry
entries.note: Registry of the vendor's assistant tool bundles, read from the vendor's own manifest; BifrOSt has no vendor tool bundles to register.

entries.name: FlowToolsRunner
entries.note: Runner for the vendor's assistant tools, limited by an allowed-clients list of the vendor's own processes.

entries.name: FlowToolsRuntime
entries.note: Runtime that loads the vendor's assistant tool bundles (WhoAmI and draft-message tools in its manifest); BifrOSt's assistant has its own tool model.

entries.name: FlowToolsShared
entries.note: Shared types of the vendor's assistant tool runtime; it serves that assistant only.

entries.name: FlowToolsSnippetService
entries.note: Renders the vendor's assistant answer cards through its own snippet plugins (calendar, mail, timers); BifrOSt has no vendor card plugins.

entries.name: Focus
entries.note: Do Not Disturb can be switched on by hand or by a daily schedule that may cross midnight; banners and wakes are silenced while alarms still sound. Gap: named Focus modes with their own app and person filters are not built.

entries.name: FocusSettingsUI
entries.note: The Do Not Disturb schedule page (on, from, to, 24-hour clock) sits under Focus settings. Gap: per-activity Focus modes and their settings pages are not built.

entries.name: FolderActionsKit
entries.note: Pure model: an attached intent runs once for each new file in a watched folder, and the first listing never runs actions. Gap: the module is declared but the shell does not yet feed watch events to its registry, and there is no UI to attach an action.

entries.name: FontServices
entries.note: private framework, owner CoreText; from SDK matrix core-text.json

entries.name: FoundInAppsPlugins
entries.note: Apps index their own items and the Search panel lists matches under Documents, opening them in the app. Gap: there is no plugin point that lets an app add results from its own search code.

entries.name: FoundationODR
entries.note: private framework, owner Foundation; from SDK matrix foundation-app-support.json, foundation-files-persistence.json, foundation-fundamentals.json, foundation-networking-lowlevel.json

entries.name: FramePacing
entries.note: The compositor keeps a frame clock from vblank timestamps and schedules each compose ahead of the next vblank. Gap: not verified on the lab machine; the frame budget checks are host benchmarks in springboard/src/shell/frame_budget.rs.

entries.name: FrontBoard
entries.note: The shell starts apps over a socket pair, holds each app's newest presented surface and gives every app its own resource ownership. Gap: there is no scene model, so an app cannot host several scenes and per-scene state restore is missing.

entries.name: FrontBoardServices
entries.note: Covers app process and surface lifecycle as in the shell app host and the per-app resource manager. Gap: no scene-level services; not verified on the lab machine.

entries.name: FuseBoardServices
entries.note: Only the Info.plist and version file are in the reference extract; the name suggests board fuse data, but no binary or resource confirmed it, and the binary is not in the index.

entries.name: FusionTracker
entries.note: Only Info.plist and version.plist were extracted (com.apple.FusionTracker 1.0), with no binary or symbols, so its purpose cannot be determined from the reference image; left os until the binary is extracted.

entries.name: Futhark
entries.note: Bundle holds only an Espresso recognition model (recognition.espresso.net, weights and shape) and no code, so the recognizer it serves is not named; left os.
